Native MinKNOW run-folder ingestion: kuma_core ingest_run_folder/is_minknow_run_dir orchestrator <-> AnalyzeRawRunParams (composed from shared DemuxParamsBase) <-> analyze handler raw-run path <-> TS AnalysisParams raw-run fields <-> inputSlice single analyze call. Demux param names must stay identical across DemuxParamsBase, AnalyzeRawRunParams, and AnalysisParams.

Optional analyze-response yield fields that explain a zero-verdict run: DemuxStats counters -> ingest_run_folder stats_out sink -> analyze response keys (total_reads, passed_mapq, passed_coverage, assigned_reads, wells_with_reads) -> TS AnalyzeYield -> pickAnalyzeYield narrowing -> EmptyAnalysisNotice rows. Every key is optional by contract and is OMITTED, never zero-filled, when the mode cannot produce it (consensus-dir mode runs no demux). Adding a counter on the Python side without extending AnalyzeYield and pickAnalyzeYield silently drops it before it reaches the notice. The seven drop_* counters (drop_short_window_read_5p, drop_short_window_read_3p, drop_no_barcode_f, drop_no_barcode_r, drop_ambiguous_tie_f, drop_ambiguous_tie_r, drop_both_axes) travel the same chain and say WHY a read that cleared both gates reached no well. They PARTITION DemuxStats.ambiguous_dropped, one bucket per failed alignment hit, with a hit that failed on both axes charged to drop_both_axes alone; tests/mame/test_demux_drop_reasons.py pins that identity on all three matching paths, so a new bucket must be added to the partition rather than beside it. ambiguous_dropped itself is NOT on the analyze response and is not renamed here despite naming the rarest of the four causes, because it is shipped on the mame.run_combinatorial_demux RPC result, in per-NB stage markers, and in the contamination ambiguous_dropped rate. Two of the seven are keyed on the READ END rather than the F/R axis on purpose: the window is cut from the read, the 3' end is the one that comes up short on real runs, and which axis that surfaces on is decided by strand, so an axis-keyed tally splits one phenomenon in two. These seven have one omission case the other keys do not: a per-NB resume that reuses a completion marker written before the breakdown existed omits ALL SEVEN, since such a marker records only the total.

Minor-allele strand evidence, reported only, no gate reads it: consensus.py measures the weak-strand share and the top-K mix-eligible positions -> consensus_metadata.py encodes them as FASTA header keys (max_minor_allele_strand_share / _plus / _minus emitted ONLY when a share exists, eligible_positions always, noisy_positions as pos:frac:depth:plus:minus records) -> fasta_parser.py decodes them -> BarcodeRecord mirrors them -> _serialize_verdict/_deserialize_verdict carry them -> TS VerdictRecord. Two things break when these are edited apart. (1) The share is Optional the whole way down because 0.0 is the ARTIFACT reading (minor allele on one strand only) and absence is unknown; any layer that defaults it to 0.0 or zero-fills the omitted key reports one-strand evidence that was never measured. (2) noisy_positions is a truncated top-K, and n_eligible_positions is the only signal saying so (n_mixed_positions counts only positions over the 0.20 gate, which is 0 on a healthy run); dropping the count on any layer turns a sample into an apparent census. The encoding lives once in format_noisy_positions/parse_noisy_positions, and excel_writer.py reuses the writer, so changing the separators or field order requires changing both halves together.

Coverage uniformity and consensus identity, reported only, no gate reads them: well_consensus.py defines depth_stats and consensus_identity ONCE and both consensus paths call them (compute_well_consensuses for sorted barcode directories, _compute_well_consensus for the raw MinKNOW run folder, which is the primary user-facing input) -> consensus_metadata.py encodes them as FASTA header keys -> fasta_parser.py decodes them -> BarcodeRecord mirrors them -> _serialize_verdict/_deserialize_verdict carry them -> TS VerdictRecord, with excel_writer.py writing the same five as columns. Three things break when these are edited apart. (1) None means NOT MEASURED at every layer and 0.0 is a real reading (a flat well, a consensus matching the reference nowhere); any layer that defaults to 0.0, coerces with `or 0.0`, or writes a 0 cell reports a measurement nobody made. (2) The five gate INDEPENDENTLY, unlike the minor-allele strand trio: a well with no reads has a real breadth_at_mix_min_depth of 0.0 while the other four are unmeasurable, so guarding them as one block drops that 0.0. (3) Both paths must read the SAME per-position depth vector mean depth comes from, which is why the formulas live in one module and are imported rather than restated; two copies would be two metrics wearing one name. breadth is scoped to DEFAULT_MIX_MIN_DEPTH (consensus.py), not to the caller's min_depth, or the field name lies.

Step 3 단일 파이프라인 계약: 조립/strict NGS gate <-> Pydantic request <-> dispatcher/handler response <-> TS RPC type/client <-> 프로젝트별 form state/UI <-> Analyze round evidence 연결. primary source는 activity_path, gc_data_xlsx, round1_report_xlsx 중 정확히 하나이고 verdict_xlsx는 필수다. 응답 키와 TS 필드명은 byte-for-byte 일치하며 round evidence signature 변경은 완료 서명을 무효화한다.

The '### Highlights' block of every CHANGELOG.md section generates src/locales/en.json whatsNewDialog.releases (per version) plus releaseStamps (one sha256 digest8 per version), and the newest of those is also written as whatsNewDialog.highlights with highlightsStamp ('<version>+<digest8>'). The nine other locales hand-translate both arrays and copy both stamp values. The modal shows every release between the version an operator last ran and the one now installed, so a past release stays on screen and a reworded past bullet leaves nine translations behind. Editing a bullet, in a new release or inside one, means regenerating en.json (node scripts/gen-whatsnew.mjs) and retranslating the affected versions in all nine; node scripts/backfill-whatsnew-archive.mjs recovers past translations from git history when an archive is missing rather than merely stale. Enforcement is elsewhere and stays there: gen-whatsnew.mjs --check owns CHANGELOG-to-en drift, scripts/i18n-parity.mjs owns the nine stamps and the translated authoring rules. This group is the co-edit reminder, hence warning. Deliberately no 'symbols': there is nothing here whose disappearance this group should announce that gen-whatsnew.mjs --check and i18n-parity.mjs do not already fail on. Note that scripts/sync-check.mjs now scans symbols at every severity (a warning group reports a miss as WARN), so adding them here would run, unlike before.

analyze response always carries layout_provenance (which of the three well->sample sources scored this run) and mapping_integrity (whole-run self/cross mapping sanity check, kuma_core/mame/qc/mapping_integrity.py) <-> TS LayoutProvenance/MappingIntegrity <-> the review-screen alert reading mapping_integrity.suspect. useAutosaveHydration.ts's well_layout promotion guard also depends on layout_provenance.source; do not drop the field without checking that guard.

Which unit directories belong to the run that filled a demux output folder: ingest_run_folder writes the manifest (unit_manifest.py) into demux_output_dir after the units are on disk -> load_barcode_directory reads it and narrows itself to the units it names, whatever the caller passed -> leftovers travel out through the strays_out sink, through route_ingest, to the analyze response 'stale_units' -> TS StaleUnits -> StaleUnitsNotice. Four things break if these are edited apart. (1) The narrowing decision belongs in the READER, not at a call site. The parameter form of this (load_barcode_directory units=) already existed and only protected the one caller that remembered it; the analyze handler ingests the same tree a SECOND time after ingest_run_folder returns, passed nothing, and scored three plates of the previous day alongside the three selected (2026-08-10, four verdict workbooks). Moving the decision back to a call site restores that defect. (2) NO manifest means NO CLAIM, never zero units: an externally sorted directory a user points MAME at directly carries none and every subdirectory must still be read, which is why units_of folds an empty or corrupt claim into None rather than honouring it. (3) stale_units is OMITTED when the read had no manifest to compare against and PRESENT-with-empty-names when it had one and found nothing, and those are different statements; zero-filling the first claims a check nobody ran. Same optional-by-contract rule as the mame-analyze-yield-fields chain. (4) Strays are reported and excluded, never deleted or moved: removing a previous run output is the operator decision, and this code has no way to know the folder is not the only copy. The per-unit stage_marker.py answers a different question (is THIS unit complete) and resume depends on it, so the two must not be merged.
File 메뉴는 FileMenu 하나가 그린다. 두 메뉴바는 앱 고유 항목만 extraItems 로 넘긴다. 한쪽 메뉴바만 고치면 v0.13.35.1 처럼 이름만 같고 내용이 갈린다. 라벨 키도 menu.file/menu.edit 로 공유한다.

Snapshot writers stamp result_contract; hydration compares it and refuses to show another contract's run. A change to what analyze produces must add a RESULT_CONTRACT_REVISIONS entry, or an obsolete saved run keeps being presented as current.
What an analyze run produces vs the revision table that dates it. Changing verdicts, replicate selection, ordering or a refusal without adding a revision leaves every older project silently trusted.

RunHealthData travels core -> handler dict -> panel with no schema between them, so a renamed or dropped field surfaces as an empty section rather than an error. The cross-talk fields are the reason this group exists: detect_cross_talk reads barcode_distribution and returns a status instead of raising when that mapping is keyed by native barcode, which is what the raw-run path produces, so the check reports not_run and the panel shows nothing. Whoever changes what fills barcode_distribution has to say what the panel then displays. Stray-read counting no longer lives here at all: it reads the demux matrix (kuma_core/mame/qc/contamination.py, analyze response `contamination`).

Whether a run could have been scored at all: core grading <-> flow cell history read from report_*.json <-> the analyze response block <-> TS type <-> store field and setter <-> the notice that stands above the verdict table. Three couplings drift silently if edited apart. (1) The depth floor is CompareParams.min_read_count, so changing that changes what this grades and the sourced comment in models.py has to move with it. (2) Depth is measured over VERDICTS, not ingested records, so a declared selection already excludes the wells the campaign left empty; measuring records instead would report a thin plate for a run that used ten wells of ninety-six. (3) Every threshold carries a `kind` and the notice renders it, because the floor is a vendor WORKFLOW DEFAULT (ONT wf-amplicon minimum_mean_depth) rather than a specification, and this repo already shipped that overstatement once as a bare 'recommended minimum' comment. Pore counts and reuse are reported with no threshold on purpose: 800 would condemn a cell that returned 515 reads a well, and 'pores at least the sample count' would pass the one that returned 4. (4) The nested `position_recurrence` block rides this same chain rather than a group of its own: it is built by summarise_position_recurrence/serialise_position_recurrence, attached to the run_quality dict in analyze.py, mirrored on the TS RunQuality, and therefore carried into the store by the existing setRunQuality. It reads the per-well noisy_positions produced by the mame-minor-allele-strand-evidence group, so the two move together when that encoding changes. Three things break if edited apart. It grades NOTHING, for the same reason the pore counts do not; the only restriction on the table is that a position seen in a single well has not recurred, which is definitional and is counted in positions_single_well rather than dropped. Its counts are a LOWER BOUND because each well contributes a top-ten sample of n_eligible_positions and every well of both measured runs was truncated, so wells_truncated and lower_bound must survive every layer. And the weak-strand share stays Optional here too: absent is unknown, 0.0 is a minor allele read off one strand, and a layer that folds one into the other reports evidence nobody measured. Nothing RENDERS the block yet; RunQualityNotice.tsx is untouched and stays in this group so a future rendering moves with the shape. (5) The nested `read_length` block rides the same chain for the same reason, and reads the SAME report_*.json flow_cell.py does, through the one shared find_report_json so the two readers can never disagree about which report a run has. Four things break if edited apart. Its N50 is QUOTED from MinKNOW, never recomputed, and its provenance entry says so; a layer that recalculates it publishes a different number under the instrument's name. There is no single N50: the measured run carried three, one of them with no read_length_type at all, so a layer that collapses them to one publishes a figure whose definition nobody can recover. bucket_values are BASES (verified by recomputing the stated n50 both ways), which is why every fraction is named *_bases_fraction and is null unless bucket_value_type is the verified ReadLengths; renaming without re-verifying makes the field lie. And null means NOT READ at every layer: no report json, an unreadable one, or a MinKNOW too old to write read_length_histogram, none of which is a run whose reads had no lengths, so no layer may zero-fill or default. It grades nothing, like the pore counts and for the same reason: an N50 at twice the reference is both a concatemer population and a deliberately long amplicon.

The sampled read length distribution behind the auto-detected amplicon length: detect_amplicon_length builds distribution_summary -> the demux handler passes that dict through verbatim -> the TS AmpliconLengthDistributionSummary names its keys. The dict is handed over untyped, so a key added on one side and not the other is invisible until a component reads undefined. The percentiles come from the same in-hand vector as the modal peak and add no pass over the reads; they exist because min/median/max cannot tell a tight amplicon from a smear around the same centre, and max is set by whichever single 200 kb read the sample caught. They are optional on the TS side because a project saved before they existed carries none, and a missing percentile is not a read of length 0. Percentiles are interpolated (statistics.quantiles method=inclusive) then truncated the way the neighbouring median already is, so no reported length exceeds a read that was seen; changing that definition changes every stored summary's meaning without changing its shape.

Stray-read signals: the per-NB demux matrix (per_nb_out sink) -> qc.contamination -> raw-run-only `contamination` response key -> TS ContaminationReport -> store field -> panel. Signal names are a fixed list on both sides; adding one on the Python side without extending CONTAMINATION_SIGNAL_NAMES drops it before the panel. Every signal is `ok` with a value or `unavailable` with a reason, never zero-filled, so nothing in this chain may substitute 0 for a missing measurement.

_decide_core가 T2/T3/T_model과 T1만 결정에 쓰고 T4/T_active/T_unused를 informational로 강등한 근거는 2026-06-08 backtest다. 그 근거 문서는 원래 kuma 밖 형제 저장소(mame_backtest, 리모트 없음)의 report_final.md만 가리키고 있어서 다른 머신에서 해석 불가능했다. docs/ 안으로 옮겨 적어 코드와 함께 이동하게 했다. 결정 트리에서 어떤 신호가 쓰이는지 바꾸면 이 문서의 '코드가 여기에 의존하는 지점' 절도 같이 고쳐야 한다. 반대로 문서만 고치고 코드를 안 고치면 강등 근거와 실제 동작이 어긋난다.

sigma_assay 와 r 이 무엇을 재는 양인지의 근거는 docs/2026-08-19-mame-assay-noise-model.md 다. 핵심은 sqrt(2/r) 이 r 번 평균이 비교가 노출된 분산을 실제로 평균해 없앨 때만 맞다는 것이다. Agilent 경로에서 변이 웰의 반복은 같은 웰의 재주입(injection)이라 웰간 분산을 줄이지 않고, WT_1/WT_2/WT_3 는 서로 다른 웰이다. 따라서 v0.16.30.01 이 실어 나른 반복 개수를 그대로 r 에 넣으면 없던 오차가 생긴다. 임계값 공식이나 r 의 출처를 바꾸면 이 문서의 '두 종류의 반복' 절과 '무엇을 먼저 재야 하는가' 절을 같이 고쳐야 한다. 문서만 고치고 코드를 두면 잡음 모델의 근거와 실제 계산이 어긋난다.

strategy.classify_round 계약: 핸들러 응답 두 형태(decision / not_assessable)와 그 키·reason 코드 <-> TS 타입 <-> RPC 클라이언트 <-> 카드 렌더 <-> round_files 조립 <-> step 완료 판정. round_files 항목은 {n, path, wt_values?} 이고 wt_values 는 가장 큰 n 항목만 읽힌다(부트스트랩은 현재 라운드를 리샘플한다). not_assessable 의 reason 은 wt_replicates_missing(0개)과 wt_replicates_insufficient(부족)로 갈리고 wt_replicate_count/wt_replicate_min 을 함께 싣는다. 문서만 남고 코드가 갈라지는 사고가 실제로 있었다: 4.2 가 WT 반복값을 받을 수 있게 된 뒤에도 ipc.ts 의 @param 과 mameStepCompletion.ts 의 주석이 'xlsx 포맷이 그 입력을 담을 수 없다'로 남아 있었다.

AGENTS.md lists Settings UI changes as a charter trigger, and reading it as documentation was not enough. v0.16.36 disabled two telemetry toggles and labelled them as not yet active, which reads as a feature waiting to be switched on; section 10 of the charter makes zero outbound telemetry release-blocking, so the honest answer was to remove them, and v0.16.37 did. The same omission produced a proposal to make the cancel timeout configurable, which section 22 and section 1 both forbid by fixing that wait at 5 s. Pairing the dialog with the charter puts the governing document in context at the moment the dialog is edited, rather than relying on someone remembering the trigger list.

step 4.1 의 label-mismatch 승인 체크박스는 상시 노출을 그만두고, 빌드가 실제로 label swap 으로 거절됐을 때만 에러 패널 안에 나타난다. 그 판정은 백엔드 예외 문구에 'Label swap detected' 가 들어 있는지로 하며(describeRpcError 가 원문을 그대로 돌려준다), 문구를 바꾸면 체크박스가 영영 나타나지 않아 사용자가 검토 후 재빌드할 방법이 사라진다. 실패는 조용하다: 타입검사도 테스트도 문구 일치를 보지 않는다. 예외 문구를 고칠 때 패널의 매칭도 같이 고칠 것.
